review.method: Acceptance suite run locally with the retail capability (CS_GAME_DIR) and the engine image (CS_ENGINE_IMAGE); the report is derived from the recorded log plus a second production pass recorded in ordnance-media-table.json. MEASURED (record names, declared resource names, addresses and counts only; provenance static, never verified_original): the weapon parser fills every media field through one shared 0x64-byte effect-block reader (0x5ae990) — FIRE parses into weapon+0x94 (site 0x5ae0fc), FLYOUT into +0xf8 (0x5ae10e), IMPACT into per-surface rows at +0x15c stride 0x64 keyed by the registered soil table 0x637b10 (0x5ae1cf), and DESTROY_ANIMATION resolves through 0x523820 into +0x188 (0x5adc33); the block's key map is ANIMATION->+0x04/+0x08 (two handles), ANIMATION_ATTACHED->+0x14, MODEL_ANIMATION->+0x18, SURFACE_ANIMATION->+0x1c, ANIMATION_MIN_RANGE->+0x20, EFFECT->+0x24 via 0x526160, MODEL->+0x28 via 0x5aec00, SOUND->+0x2c/+0x30.., BOUNCE_SOUND->+0x40/+0x44.. via 0x596120. The launch one-shot is the record's declared FIRE>SOUND entry selected by the caller through 0x5ac120 (slot index signed-below the count, -1 = silence) and played through gate 0x593b80 which early-outs on a null handle — no SOUND_NAME key exists (the only occurrence is LOOPED_SOUND_NAME's tail, parsed at 0x4baa7b into the mount descriptor as the gun loop), there is no shared rocket sound except shared declarations (snd_missile_sm/snd_missile_bg), no mount fallback and no fallback at all: absent means silent. The detonation is per-surface (row EFFECT +0x24 at 0x5aca01, SURFACE_ANIMATION +0x1c, ANIMATION +0x04/+0x08, SOUND picked uniformly at 0x5ad100); DESTROY_ANIMATION plays on a round ending in flight (0x5af78b) and as the detonation fallback (0x5b06b8); FLYOUT>MODEL attaches to the spawned round (0x5aecbf). wep_14: FIRE>SOUND snd_missile_bg, MODEL a_torpedo + torpedo_trail, FLYOUT>SOUND snd_torpedo_loop, DESTROY_ANIMATION torpedo_destroy_effect. NOT CLAIMED: any original-run behavior (retail is read access, no agent ran the original); the FLYOUT>SOUND runtime consumer (parsed at +0x124/+0x128, no weapon-module consumer proven); the meaning of ANIMATION's int-child flag bit; the mapping of logical sound names to wave members (the sounds.zrd SETS/SOUND_GROUPS registry, a follow-up). The claim is implemented: a code and test pass awards nothing above that, and no agent review replaces the owner's human approval. Validated with tools/validate_evidence.py --require-pass.
